release.notes: DEV TEST ONLY — Build 15.10.14 Live Crash Logger (vc75). Replaces the temporary MIDI/SoundFont profiler with an app-local crash logger in Settings. Saves uncaught Java/Kotlin crashes before Android terminates the app and logs handled playback errors. Android 11+ may add native crash/ANR exit reasons on next app launch; native stack traces are not guaranteed. Black-and-gold live-refresh viewer with Test, Copy, Clear, Close; up to 48 entries stored locally, no automatic upload. Silent test mode: no automatic update banners or notifications, manual Developer OTA checks work. Phase 1 library optimization, MIDI lyrics, melody, SoundFont playback, scoring, remote and queue retained. Beta/Stable untouched.
